elements.text: Unairworthy bannis latches not complying with Airworthiness Directives 86-09-09 and 2001-15-01 were installed on in-service Boeing 757 series airplanes.
The same non-compliant bannis latch design used on Boeing 757s is also used on Boeing 727 and 737 airplanes, creating a risk of incorrect configuration on those models.
Operators' maintenance documentation lacked consistent and accurate depictions of the correct bannis latch assembly configuration.
The NTSB recommends requiring FAA to mandate inspections and modifications for Boeing 757 operators.
The NTSB recommends requiring inspections and modifications for Boeing 727 and 737 operators using the same latch design.
The NTSB recommends requiring Boeing 757 operators to update aircraft maintenance manuals.
The NTSB recommends requiring Boeing 727 and 737 operators to update aircraft maintenance manuals.
The NTSB recommends Boeing issue service bulletins for inspecting and modifying Boeing 757 latches.
The NTSB recommends Boeing issue service bulletins for inspecting and modifying Boeing 727 and 737 latches.
The NTSB recommends Boeing review and revise maintenance manuals for Boeing 727 and 737 models.
